rationale: The assistant correctly identified the click-hum-stop pattern as the overload tripping on a failed compressor start, named start relay/PTC and a tiring compressor as the main suspects, and gave safe unplugged cleaning/ventilation steps before escalating to an engineer (F-gas for sealed system). It used the customer's answers (10 years, very hot compressor, worse in warm weather) and kept the relay swap framed as a hedged 'cheap gamble' with an engineer alternative rather than a certain fix. Minor weaknesses: the second turn leans somewhat confidently toward overheating, repeats the plug/space/clean advice, and the relay recommendation precedes confirmation by test or engineer; it also mentioned a control board as a low-probability cause.
